title: Extract CME Group 10-K Receivables
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open CME Group Inc.'s annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2010. In that filing, find the line item "Receivables from brokers (a component of other current assets)" and report its value for each of these periods: 2010 and 2009. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: CME Group Inc.'s fiscal year 2010 Form 10-K, Note 5, Other Current Assets, lists 'Receivables from brokers' at December 31.
